data.name: Falguni
data.gender_notes: Falguni is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Sanskrit word 'Falguna', it means 'born in spring' or 'the month of spring'. The name Falguni carries the meaning “Born in Spring” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Falguni usually hope their child will grow to embody born in spring and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Falguni belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Born in Spring.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Falguni total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Falguni, being a name of Indian origin, conveys a rich cultural heritage. The name is a nod to the Indian calendar with its association to the festive month of Falgun, which falls around late February and early March. This month is celebrated with the Holi festival, marking the victory of good over evil and the arrival of spring. The lively spirit and celebratory nature of the name reflect the vibrant Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Falguni can be considered a divine name, representing the embodiment of enthusiasm, joy, and positivity. It is associated with Goddess Agni, who signifies power, strength, and transformation. The name Falguni can be a reminder to look inward, embrace the spiritual journey, and celebrate life with joy and gratitude.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Falguni signifies the radiant and playful aspect of spring. It is a name imbued with warmth and energy, evoking images of the sun's rays caressing the earth and heralding new life. It symbolizes joy, creativity, and the vitality of nature.

historical_references.reference: Falguni is believed to be the name of the goddess of spring and love in Hinduism, identified with the Roman goddess Venus.
The name Falguni is also associated with the Hindu month of Falgun, which falls in late February or early March in the Gregorian calendar.
